before.blocker: Live unsigned Debug launch crashed after Downloads access because startup reconciliation assumed object identities were path-unique; hard-linked files legitimately violate that assumption.

acceptance_evidence.reference: SQLite schema v2 and atomic recordObservation persist scope, observation, per-root coverage, stable objects, temporal paths, file states, current state, changes, and gaps
recordObservation transaction and observation ID replay test prove rollback and idempotency
EvidenceObjectLifecycleTests covers baseline, modify, truncate, rename, replace, delete, path reuse, partial unknown, and scope entry/exit
PersistentMonitoringProbe uses durable state and restart test records resolved app-offline gap
Complete and partial A/B/C tests prove deletion only after complete same-scope observation

discovered_risks: Path-temporal fallback identity cannot prove replacement when filesystem identity metadata is unavailable; such conclusions remain observational.
Existing legacy evidence-event-v1 exports do not yet expose every v2 lifecycle field; TASK-243 and TASK-244 own bounded export and query projections.

evidence: Schema v2 retains v1 tables and adds scope_versions, observation_runs, observation_roots, file_objects, path_bindings, file_state_observations, current_file_state, change_events, and coverage_gaps
recordObservation applies all derived mutations inside one SQLite transaction and returns an existing observation without replay
EvidenceObjectLifecycleTests verifies complete A/B/C deletion and idempotent replay
Partial A/B/C keeps B unknown, non-actionable, and state-as-of O1 until a complete recovery observation
Identity-aware tests distinguish modify, truncate, rename, replacement/path reuse, scope entry, and scope exit
Scope removal emits scope-exit rather than deletion
Restart test reopens persisted state, records a bounded app-offline interval, and reconciles deletion only from a complete observation
Complete root coverage resolves earlier open root gaps without removing their history
swift test passed 111 tests with zero failures
git diff --check passed
Evidence contract explicitly limits hard-link, clone, compression, and path-temporal identity conclusions
